t: This is the site of the Serpentine Gallery Pavilion from 2003, a building that no longer stands. It was designed by Oscar Niemeyer, the Brazilian architect widely seen as one of the key figures of modern architecture. He is best known for the civic buildings of Brasília, which became Brazil's capital in 1960, and for his work on the United Nations headquarters in New York. His use of reinforced concrete was highly influential.
